column3: Create fixed F# class-library and xUnit projects; run one passing and one intentionally failing test in Visual Studio Test Explorer; debug the failed test and verify the xUnit equality exception; then correct the expected value and verify that both tests pass.

Open a command prompt for deterministic project setup.

Remove the fixed project directory from any previous run and report whether cleanup succeeded.

column4: Return focus to the setup command prompt.
Create the solution F# projects project reference and restore dependencies.
column6: ["cd /d \"{vars.home}\" && dotnet new sln -n FSharpXunit -o ui-auto-fsharp-xunit --format sln --force && dotnet new classlib -lang F# -f netstandard2.0 -n FSharpLibrary -o \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpLibrary\" --force && dotnet new xunit -lang F# -f net10.0 -n FSharpTests -o \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpTests\" --force && dotnet add \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpTests\\FSharpTests.fsproj\" reference \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpLibrary\\FSharpLibrary.fsproj\" && dotnet sln \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpXunit.sln\" add \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpLibrary\\FSharpLibrary.fsproj\" \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpTests\\FSharpTests.fsproj\" && dotnet restore \"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\\FSharpXunit.sln\" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json && echo SETUP_COMPLETE>\"{vars.home}\\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit-setup-{timestamp}.ready\"", "--interval", "0.001"]

column4: Submit the project setup command.

column4: Close the setup command prompt.
Write the FSharpLibrary implementation.
column6:
["--out", "{vars.home}\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\FSharpLibrary\Library.fs", "--text", "namespace FSharpLibrary

module Say =
    let func1 x = x + 3
    let result1 = func1 4
    printfn "The result of x adding 3 is %d" result1
"]

column4: Write the initial tests with an intentional expected-value failure in My test2.
column6:
["--out", "{vars.home}\ui-auto-fsharp-xunit\FSharpTests\Tests.fs", "--text", "module Tests

open Xunit

[<Fact>]
let ``My test1`` () =
    Assert.Equal(7, FSharpLibrary.Say.result1)

[<Fact>]
let ``My test2`` () =
    Assert.Equal(71, FSharpLibrary.Say.result1)
"]
